modules.name: Morph VCO
modules.description: Original first-party 16-channel oscillator with polyBLEP alias reduction, continuous sine/saw/pulse morphing, exponential FM and pulse-width modulation.

modules.name: State Filter
modules.description: Original 16-channel TPT multimode state-variable filter with simultaneous low-pass, band-pass and high-pass outputs, CV modulation and smoothly controlled nonlinear drive.

modules.name: Fold Drive
modules.description: Original 16-lane sine wavefolder with asymmetric bias, drive and wet/dry CV, short control slew and bounded audio output. Not bandlimited.

modules.name: Macro8 Performance Macros
modules.description: Eight named performance CV outputs with four recallable, smoothly morphing snapshots, and per-output unipolar or bipolar voltage modes.

modules.name: Stereo Echo
modules.description: Original MODULAR-SYNTH 16-voice stereo delay with bounded feedback, millisecond time, wet/dry and ping-pong crossfeed

modules.name: Clocked LFO
modules.description: Original 16-lane phase-continuous modulation source with sine, triangle, ramp, pulse and EOC; free frequency, external clock divisions/multipliers, Schmitt reset and CV.

modules.name: FM Voice
modules.description: Original 16-voice two-operator phase-modulation oscillator with frequency ratio, modulation-index and feedback CV; no oversampling or bandlimit.

modules.name: Chance Hold
modules.description: Original deterministic 16-lane probabilistic sample-and-hold CV generator with free/external clocks, per-lane seeds, glide, quantized steps and accepted-hit triggers.

modules.name: Dual VCA
modules.description: Original independent dual 16-channel gain amplifiers with normalled 10 V envelope CV, linear-to-cubic response curves, 2 ms slew and bounded A, B and SUM outputs.

modules.name: Slew Glide
modules.description: Original 16-lane asymmetrical CV slew with independent rise/fall time and CV, simultaneous linear and exponential outputs and motion gate. Input/output limited to +/-10 V.

modules.name: Scale Quantizer
modules.description: Original scale-aware 16-lane 1 V/oct CV quantizer with eight pitch-class modes, root/transpose CV, adjustable hysteresis and a pitch-change trigger. Source-DSP verified, not yet auditioned in a host.
